claims: Crimson Desert is set for a simultaneous worldwide release on March 19, 2026.
Crimson Desert is an open-world action-RPG.
Crimson Desert will launch on PC (Steam, Epic Games), PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X|S.
Many players will be able to access Crimson Desert at 10pm GMT.
Pre-load for Crimson Desert is available 48 hours before launch for those who pre-order.
Pearl Abyss is the developer of Crimson Desert.
Crimson Desert features a story focused on the character Kliff.
